name: setup-manaflow-ai-nature-look
description: A whole cmux look built only from public surfaces: a theme file that turns on the Mac's clearest glass for the window, lets the wallpaper's hue lean into it, and gives light and dark their own moss, bark and leaf colors; settings for type and the sidebar; a stylesheet of cmux.agentPane.style/1 tokens for the prompt bubble and cards; and a customize view whose hover card puts its status on chip glass. Nothing is painted over your wallpaper. Remove it and everything you had comes back.

files.customize/cmux-app.json:
{
  "$schema": "https://cmux.dev/schemas/cmux-app/2.json",
  "manifestVersion": 2,
  "id": "local/customize",
  "name": { "en": "Nature hover card" },
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "description": "Nature's hover card: the title, its status on a small chip of the app's glass, what the agent is doing, and where.",
  "engines": { "cmux": "^2.0" },
  "repository": "https://github.com/local/customize",
  "runtime": { "main": "main.js" },
  "implements": {
    "cmux.hovercard/1": { "export": "renderCard" }
  },
  "scopes": { "workspace:read": "Read the hovered workspace's card." },
  "activation": ["onInterface:cmux.hovercard/1"],
  "files": ["main.js"]
}
files.themes/nature.json:
// Nature: the wallpaper leads. The window is the Mac's clearest glass (Liquid Glass, clear) with
// only half a tint of the theme's background, so your own picture is what you see through the
// titlebar, the tab strip and the sidebar; the glass leans toward its hue. Nothing is painted over
// it. The chat is the content layer at 86%, enough for text to read on a mid-tone picture.
// Light (morning moss) and dark (forest floor) both come from this one file, and follow the Mac's
// appearance. Under Reduce Transparency the app paints the theme background opaque instead.
{
  "name": "Nature",
  "description": "Your wallpaper through the clearest glass, moss and bark colors, a leaf-green accent.",

  "appearance.theme": "light:Builtin Light,dark:Builtin Dark",
  "appearance.appTheme": "followTerminal",
  "appearance.themeEdits": {
    // Forest floor: a green-black ground, lichen-white text, new leaf as the accent.
    "Builtin Dark/background": "#0f1a14",
    "Builtin Dark/foreground": "#eaf2e6",
    "Builtin Dark/cursor": "#a9e3b4",
    "Builtin Dark/selection": "#243a2c",
    "Builtin Dark/accent": "#8fd19e",
    "Builtin Dark/0": "#26352b",
    "Builtin Dark/1": "#f0867b",
    "Builtin Dark/2": "#8fd19e",
    "Builtin Dark/3": "#e6c36a",
    "Builtin Dark/4": "#7fb5e6",
    "Builtin Dark/5": "#c7a6e6",
    "Builtin Dark/6": "#6fd3c4",
    "Builtin Dark/7": "#cfd8cc",
    "Builtin Dark/8": "#8da38f",
    "Builtin Dark/9": "#f7a79e",
    "Builtin Dark/10": "#a9e3b4",
    "Builtin Dark/11": "#f1d792",
    "Builtin Dark/12": "#a1cbf0",
    "Builtin Dark/13": "#dac3f0",
    "Builtin Dark/14": "#93e4d8",
    "Builtin Dark/15": "#f4f8f1",
    // Morning moss: a pale green-white ground, bark-green ink, a deep leaf accent that stays a mark
    // on the clearest glass over a dark picture.
    "Builtin Light/background": "#f3f6ee",
    "Builtin Light/foreground": "#16241b",
    "Builtin Light/cursor": "#185f2c",
    "Builtin Light/selection": "#d3e4cb",
    "Builtin Light/accent": "#185f2c",
    "Builtin Light/0": "#16241b",
    "Builtin Light/1": "#9c2a18",
    "Builtin Light/2": "#185f2c",
    "Builtin Light/3": "#6f5000",
    "Builtin Light/4": "#1d4f91",
    "Builtin Light/5": "#6b3fa0",
    "Builtin Light/6": "#0a5f54",
    "Builtin Light/7": "#4a5d4e",
    "Builtin Light/8": "#566a59",
    "Builtin Light/9": "#a8301d",
    "Builtin Light/10": "#1a5e2d",
    "Builtin Light/11": "#6e4f00",
    "Builtin Light/12": "#1b4580",
    "Builtin Light/13": "#5e3592",
    "Builtin Light/14": "#0b5e54",
    "Builtin Light/15": "#f3f6ee"
  },
  "appearance.accent": "theme",

  // The window: no painting, the clearest glass, half a tint. The Clear preset in Settings is
  // 0.35; 0.5 is the lowest that keeps chrome text at 7.5:1 or more over a mid-tone picture (the
  // two extremes, pure black and pure white, are in DESIGN.md).
  "appearance.background": "none",
  "appearance.backgroundBlur": "glass-clear",
  "appearance.backgroundOpacity": 0.5,
  "appearance.glassTransparency": 0,
  "appearance.wallpaperTint": true,

  // Chrome is the glass (no override), the chat is a plane over it.
  "appearance.chromeStyle": "flat",
  "appearance.sidebarSurface": "same",
  "appearance.surfaces.agentPane.opacity": 0.86,
  "sidebar.sectionLook": "quiet",

  // The address bar's glass takes a faint leaf tint.
  "browser.omnibar.glassTint": "accent",
  "browser.omnibar.glassTintStrength": 0.1,

  "appearance.statusIndicator.style": "arc",
  "appearance.density": "comfortable"
}
